COD.rationale: Content entries (coordinates/colors), separate origin/organization metadata, and distinct status/origin fields are all explicitly present and bound to the same referents/times.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content descriptions (color-labeled coordinate sets) are present for current and candidate records.

D.rationale: Content (color/coordinate) entries are presented separately from origin/status metadata for the same referents and times.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization metadata describe how contents are presented or derived (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, completed_record).
